request.question:
Which public classes in auto_ontology/connectors are used only as base classes: subclassed by other non-test classes but never constructed by a resolved call? Give the number of non-test subclasses of each.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string), subclasses (integer).
Return every requested field using exactly its specified column alias. Preserve complete case-sensitive repository-relative paths and symbol IDs; do not substitute display names. Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text. These questions concern a static map of open-source Python code. Describe what the query computes and the assumptions it makes; the returned rows are reported separately. Questions asking which files, modules or symbols mean distinct identities, not one repeated row per matching import or call occurrence; preserve occurrence counts only when requested. Caller/callee graph questions include methods as well as standalone functions unless a symbol kind is explicitly restricted. Use files.is_test for test-file classification; test_links describe associations, not the complete set of test files. Use DOUBLE or DECIMAL, rather than single-precision REAL, for percentage calculations.
request.evidence: code.class_bases records the base classes named in each class statement; base_symbol_id is the internal class a base resolves to. Calling a class name creates an instance.

events.sql: SELECT s.symbol_id AS symbol_id, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT cb.class_symbol_id) AS INTEGER) AS subclasses FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS s INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb ON cb.base_symbol_id = s.symbol_id INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS ssub ON cb.class_symbol_id = ssub.symbol_id INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS fsub ON ssub.file_id = fsub.file_id WHERE s.kind = 'class' AND s.is_public = TRUE AND s.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/connectors/%' AND fsub.is_test = FALSE AND cb.class_symbol_id <> s.symbol_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auto_ontology_code.code.inbound_call_counts AS icc WHERE icc.symbol_id = s.symbol_id AND COALESCE(icc.inbound_calls, 0) > 0) GROUP BY s.symbol_id ORDER BY s.symbol_id

gold_sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.class_symbol_id) AS subclasses
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
JOIN code.class_bases b ON b.base_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols sub ON sub.symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.files sf ON sf.file_id = sub.file_id
WHERE s.kind = 'class' AND s.is_public AND NOT f.is_test AND NOT sf.is_test
  AND f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/connectors/%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.calls c WHERE c.callee_symbol_id = s.symbol_id AND c.call_kind = 'direct')
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
ORDER BY s.symbol_id;
